description: A bare `<render/>` carries no `of=`. Per §19.15.3 the subject is required and E-RENDER-NO-OF fires (§34: Error).
rationale: §19.15.3 — `<render of=expr/>` displays an enum value through its variants' `renders` clauses. Without `of=` the element names no subject and selects no variant, so there is no clause to dispatch to.
